#Final Questions:

1. Are people with more BMI prone to becoming obese? 

```{r}
A |> ggplot(aes(x = obesity, y = BMI, fill = obesity)) + geom_boxplot(color = "black")
```

```{r}
A |> gf_boxplot(BMI ~ obesity, fill = ~ obesity, title = "BMI vs. Obesity", subtitle = "2 quant variables", caption = "Plotting a Boxplot Graph")
```

```{r}
A |> group_by(obesity) |> summarise(mean_BMI = mean(BMI, na.rm = TRUE))
mosaic::t_test(BMI ~ obesity, data = A)
```

2. is obesity impacted by age?

```{r}
A |> ggplot(aes(x = age, fill = obesity)) + geom_histogram(binwidth = 5, position = "dodge", color = "black") #or you can also use A inside like this ONLY IF you're using A in the start, if you're using A in the geom_bar() it wont work., ggplot(A, aes(x=age, fill=obesity)) + geom_bar()
```

```{r}
A |> gf_histogram(~ age, fill = ~ obesity, color = "black")
```

```{r}
A |> group_by(obesity) |> summarize(mean_age = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE))
mosaic::t_test(age ~ obesity, data = A)
```

3. is obesity independent of age

```{r}
A |> ggplot(aes(x = obesity, y = age, color = sex)) + geom_boxplot()
```

```{r}
A |> group_by(age) |> summarise(mean_age = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE))
mosaic::t_test(age ~ obesity, data = A)
```

4. is TC associated with LDLC?

```{r}
A |> ggplot(aes(x = TC, y = LDLC)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.3) + geom_smooth(method = "lm")
```

5. does cholesterol increase with age?

```{r}
A |> ggplot(aes(x = TC, y = age, fill = sex)) + geom_boxplot() + geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2), alpha = 0.3) #+ geom_point() + geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE #```{r}
#A |> ggplot(aes(x = age, y = EF, color = sex)) + geom_point() + geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black")
#A |> group_by(EF) |> summarise(mean_age = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE))
#mosaic::t_test(sex ~ EF, data= A)```)
```

# Panel B — category / talk

*smoking × sex, DM × HBP, Dx × cardiogenicShock. Do not histogram smoking.*

```{r}
B <- read_csv("data/panel-B.csv")
glimpse(B)
inspect(B)
skim(B)
```
```{r}
B <- B |> mutate(sex = as.factor(sex))
B <- B |> mutate(across(where(is.character),as.factor))
B |> glimpse()
B |> inspect()
B |> skim()
```
1. does obesity differ between males and females
```{r}
library(vcd) 
vcd::structable(obesity ~ sex, data = B) |> vcd::mosaic()
vcd::structable(obesity ~ sex, data = B) |> vcd::mosaic(type = "expected")
```
y variable = measured, x = whats controlled and set by us
```{r}
mosaic::xchisq.test(obesity ~ sex, data = B)
```
x - squared = t

Question 1: Does obesity differ between males and females
```{r}
library(vcd)
 vcd::structable(sex ~ obesity, data = B) |> vcd::mosaic()
```

Question 2: Are the observed obesity patterns for males and females different from what would be expected by chance?
```{r}
library(vcd)
vcd::structable(sex ~ obesity, data = B) |> vcd::mosaic(type = "expected")
```

```{r}
 mosaic::xchisq.test(sex ~ obesity, data = B)
